title: Alberta: RCMP will not reveal deadly method of restraint: [National Edition]
article: RCMP refused to discuss a secret method of restraint police used on a man who later died, the force's lawyer said.
"It's a good way to kill someone, so it's not something the ... RCMP wants made public," Christine Ashcroft said at an inquiry into the death of Kenneth Holt, who was creating a disturbance.
Mr. Holt had a fractured larynx.
